title: An Oak Tree (Accessible Name)
summary: A plain glass of water whose HTML accessible name is consecrated into an oak tree while not one pixel changes.
mechanism: An image's aria-label / accessible name (read live from the DOM) is flipped from 'A glass of water' to 'An oak tree' while the SVG stays byte-identical; no storage, no network.
references: Arthur Danto, The Transfiguration of the Commonplace (1981)
HTML alt attribute / the accessible name (WAI)
